study_title: IKAROS Gene Regulatory Network Reveal ERG as a Vulnerability in B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
study_status: Preprint version 1; not peer reviewed at source inspection

annotation_audit.source: Official UCSC hg38 wgEncodeGencodeAttrsV36 transcript attributes collapsed to unambiguous geneId/geneName/geneType tuples

correlation_source.relationship: Schjerven-coauthored collaborator software, verified through the 2021 primary publication
correlation_source.adaptation: Source-defined Pearson feature-by-sample count matrix primitive adapted from peak counts to gene counts; not full ssvQC or R execution. Added log2(CPM+1) sensitivity view.

limitations: Eight libraries: n=2 biological replicates per condition and model; four cross-condition ratios are sensitivity comparisons, not four replicates or confidence intervals.

PDX2 data were reused from the 2017 GSE90659 deposit and reprocessed in GSE310958. Model and historical preparation/instrument are confounded; compare within-model effects, not absolute cross-model expression.
All effects are descriptive; no p-values, differential-expression significance, causal target discovery or clinical inference.
RNA counts do not establish protein activity or surface abundance; gene-level IKZF1 cannot separate endogenous mutant and induced IK1 transcripts.
Selection criteria are exploratory assay-prioritization choices, not validated biological/QC cutoffs. Independent assay validation and appropriate controls are required.
Median-ratio normalization assumes sufficiently many comparable genes; no spike-ins or absolute RNA measurement. Normalization sensitivity is shown rather than assumed away.

formulas.mean_effect: log2(mean(normalized IK1 counts) / mean(normalized GFP counts)); missing if either mean is zero; no pseudocount
formulas.pair_range: Range of four log2(normalized IK1_j / normalized GFP_k) combinations within each model; missing if either count is zero
formulas.median_ratio: Per model: include genes positive in all four samples; divide each count by its gene geometric mean; take each column median; rescale four factors to geometric mean one
formulas.expression_floor: Both GFP and IK1 mean CPM >= selected CPM floor in each model (all four condition means must pass)
formulas.strict_support: Same mean direction in both models and all four finite cross-condition ratios per model meet the selected effect floor in that direction
formulas.log_cpm_QC: log2(assigned-count CPM + 1), used only for contextual sample correlation and not effect ratios
